description:
The 4StoreyBuilding project is loaded in eQUEST. You are a facilities engineer tasking with optimizing the water-side plant. Update the Condenser Water Loop and Cooling Tower to model a variable-speed retrofit with advanced controls.

Perform the following upgrades:
1. Navigate to the Water-Side HVAC module.
2. Locate the Condenser Water Loop (often labeled 'CW Loop') and change its Cooling Setpoint Control to 'Wet-Bulb Reset'.
3. Locate the Cooling Tower (under Heat Rejection) and change its Fan Control to 'Fan Speed Control'.
4. Set the Cooling Tower's Min Fan Speed ratio to 0.2 (20%).

After applying these changes, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to validate the model converges and save the project.
